versions.changelog:
Exa Search Skill v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces semantic web search optimized for AI agents and LLMs.
- Enables clean Markdown extraction from web pages, removing boilerplate.
- Supports extractive highlights for efficient context use in LLMs.
- Allows similarity search using example URLs for conceptual discovery.
- Provides fresh/live crawling and subpage extraction for deep research tasks.
- Includes best practices for integrating results into RAG workflows.
